field_classes.derived: computed from other data (updated, is_own_solution, legacy_v0); never edited directly
field_classes.judgement: a human assessment (ranking, rating, verification, comparability); keeps who, when and why, and is never overwritten by an import or agent (ADR-K11)
field_classes.sourced: a fact taken from a document or an import; may be refreshed by a later import unless a person set it
